_about: Every state gets one record with exactly these fields. Every field holds a value, the section it came from, and a sentence copied verbatim from the law.

record_info.state: Two letter code, e.g. Texas as TX
record_info.statute: Name of the law, e.g. Tex. Fin. Code ch. 152
record_info.source_date: Date you copied the law text, e.g. 2026-10-18

every_field_looks_like.value: The answer (either a number, true/false, a word, or a list)
every_field_looks_like.section: Where it came from, e.g. 152.352 (must match a file name in raw/STATE)
every_field_looks_like.quote: One sentence copied exactly from that section
every_field_looks_like.note: Anything a reader should know, e.g. 'bond depends on net worth'

fields.bond_structure: one of the following: flat, formula, tiered, set_by_regulator
fields.bond_min_usd: lowest bond amount in dollars, e.g. 100000
fields.bond_max_usd: highest bond amount (the cap) in dollars, or null if none
fields.net_worth_structure: one of the following: flat, formula, tiered, none
fields.net_worth_min_usd: lowest required net worth in dollars
fields.renewal_fee_usd: yearly renewal fee in dollars, or null if not found
fields.decision_days: days the regulator has to approve or deny once the application is complete
fields.exemptions: list of exemption labels from taxonomy.json, each with its paragraph number, e.g. agent_of_payee:2
